description.content: Returns ocean freight market rates within the specified parameters.

query.description: (Required) Defines the origin location of the requested market rate data. Can be either a UN/LOCODE or a region as defined in Xeneta's [geo-hierarchy](https://www.xeneta.com/hubfs/2025-ocean-geo/xeneta-ocean-geo.html). For example, `CNSGH` or `china_east_main`.

(Required) Defines the destination location of the requested market rate data. Can be either a UN/LOCODE or a region as defined in Xeneta's [geo-hierarchy](https://www.xeneta.com/hubfs/2025-ocean-geo/xeneta-ocean-geo.html). For example, `NLRTM` or `north_europe_main`.
(Required) Defines the start date of the date range for the requested market rates in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.

(Required) Defines the end date of the date range for the requested market rates in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.

Using a future date will return contracted rates that are valid up to 10 days (when `contract_length` is set to `short`) or 3 months (when `contract_length` is set to `long`) beyond the current date.
(Required) Defines the type of contract for the requested market rate data. Accepted values are `long` or `short`.

(Required) Defines the maximum age of the contracts to be included in the requested market rate data, relative to each day. Accepted values include `all`, `3months` and `6months`. Using any value other than `all` when `contract_length` is set to `short` will return an error.
(Required) Defines the container type of the requested market rate data. Accepted values include `20DC`, `20RE`, `20TK`, `40DC`, `40RH` and `40HC`.

(Required) Defines whether the requested market rate data should include the terminal handling charge. Accepted values include `meth`, `othc`, `dthc`, `none` and `both`. Selecting `meth` will use Xeneta's default [methodology](https://help.xeneta.com/docs/terminal-handling-charges) for the requested `origin` and `destination`.

Defines whether to allow rates from larger geographic regions in the response if there is not enough data for the requested `origin` and `destination`. Using `false` when there is no rate data available for the requested `origin` and `destination` will return an error.

(Required) Defines the end date of the date range for the requested estimated rates in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.
(Required) Defines the type of contract for the requested estimated rate data. Accepted values are `long` or `short`. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.

(Required) Defines the maximum age of the contracts to be included in the requested estimated rate data, relative to each day. Accepted values include `all`, `3months` and `6months`. Using any value other than `all` when `contract_length` is set to `short` will return an error.
(Required) Defines the container type of the requested market rate data. Accepted values include `20DC`, `20RE`, `20TK`, `40DC`, `40RH` and `40HC`.

(Required) Defines whether the requested market rate data should include the terminal handling charge. Accepted values include `meth`, `othc`, `dthc`, `none` and `both`. Selecting `meth` will use Xeneta's default [methodology](https://help.xeneta.com/docs/terminal-handling-charges) for the requested `origin` and `destination`.

(Required) Defines the end date of the date range for your requested imported rates in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.
(Required) Defines the container type of your requested imported rates. Accepted values include `20DC`, `20RE`, `20TK`, `40DC`, `40RH` and `40HC`.

(Required) Defines whether your requested imported rates should include the terminal handling charge. Accepted values include `meth`, `othc`, `dthc`, `none` and `both`. query.description: (Required) Defines the origin location of the requested carrier rate data. Can be either a UN/LOCODE or a region as defined in Xeneta's [geo-hierarchy](https://www.xeneta.com/hubfs/2025-ocean-geo/xeneta-ocean-geo.html). For example, `CNSGH` or `china_east_main`.

(Required) Defines the start date of the date range for the requested carrier rates in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.
(Required) Defines the end date of the date range for the requested carrier rates in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.
(Required) Defines the [carrier](ref:list-all-carriers-spread) whose rates to request.
(Required) Defines the type of contract for the requested carrier rate data. Accepted values are `long` or `short`.

(Required) Defines the maximum age of the contracts to be included in the requested carrier rate data, relative to each day. Accepted values include `all`, `3months` and `6months`. Using any value other than `all` when `contract_length` is set to `short` will return an error.
(Required) Defines the container type of the requested carrier rate data. Accepted values include `20DC`, `20RE`, `20TK`, `40DC`, `40RH` and `40HC`.

(Required) Defines whether the requested carrier rate data should include the terminal handling charge. Accepted values include `meth`, `othc`, `dthc`, `none` and `both`. Selecting `meth` will use Xeneta's default [methodology](https://help.xeneta.com/docs/terminal-handling-charges) for the requested origin and destination.

query.description: (Required) Defines the origin location of the requested schedule reliability datathat must match Xeneta's [geo-hierarchy](https://www.xeneta.com/hubfs/2025-ocean-geo/xeneta-ocean-geo.html). For example, `north_europe_main`.

(Required) Defines the destination location of the requested schedule reliability data that must match Xeneta's [geo-hierarchy](https://www.xeneta.com/hubfs/2025-ocean-geo/xeneta-ocean-geo.html). For example, `far_east_main`.
(Required) Defines the start date of the date range for the requested reliability data in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.
(Required) Defines the end date of the date range for the requested reliability data in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.
Defines the [carrier](list-all-carriers-reliability) whose reliability score will be returned in the response. If left blank, the response will not contain any carrier-specific data.

Returns carbon emissions index score for the requested [corridor](ref:list-all-corridors-emissions) and [carrier](ref:list-all-carriers-emissions).

query.description: (Required) Defines the origin location of the requested carbon emissions data. Must be a region as returned by the [available corridors](list-all-corridors-emissions) endpoint. For example, `north_europe_main`.

(Required) Defines the destination location of the requested carbon emissions data. Must be a region as returned by the [available corridors](list-all-corridors-emissions) endpoint. For example, `far_east_main`.

(Required) Defines the start date of the date range for the requested capacity data in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Note that carbon emissions data is updated on a quarterly basis, so the response will contain data for the quarter that the requested date belongs to.
Defines the [carrier](list-all-carriers-emissions) whose carbon emissions index score will be returned in the response. If left blank, the response will not contain any carrier-specific data.
